crossRefs.note: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself…
May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of…
Yahweh will render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand…
even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,
Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I…
When David’s servants had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, “David has sent us to you, to take you…
But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me…
He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

translations.web: that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When Yahweh has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant.”
translations.bsb: then my lord will have no remorse or guilt of conscience over needless bloodshed and revenge. And when the LORD has dealt well with my lord, may you remember your servant.”
translations.kjv: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.
translations.asv: that this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood without cause, or that my lord hath avenged himself. And when Jehovah shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thy handmaid.
